steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: A-Zone Prisoner
steps.text: Euggh...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (This prisoner's fierce! Knocked all the others down in just a few hits.)

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: ...Go to hell.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (This jailer's a mighty one too. She's just guarding, though, seems like. I wonder why...)

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: Heagh!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Crud, the jailer's down...)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Just me left. But if I end up fighting with him here, it's gonna be a mess to explain after.)

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: And you.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Think, c'mon. Is my only option to throw fists?)

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner B
steps.text: You're fast.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Anthony... rescued me?)

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I might not know who you are, but you shouldn't be doing this. Not this, right in front of my eyes.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Heh heh, death's knocking and you still care about other folk. You're a real gentleman, Mr. Anthony.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (When did he—?!)

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Heheh. Here, miss. Don't be scared of me. Just blame it on your rotten luck.

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Relax. Asides from Anthony, we don't wanna kill nobody. You just take a lie-down.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (Shit!)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (He got me...)

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: (I can't—think clear...)

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: ...let's...you a warm welcome...Anthony...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...dead...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I didn't expect you to be this good of a cook. Wow.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm-hmm! Betcha didn't.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Anyway, she got caught up in another assassin's attempt and lost consciousness, then...?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That must've sucked.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yeah, unlucky her.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: So how'd this assassination pan out?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We know Anthony must've won, but this was an attempt on his life in a prison. Couldn't have gone without comment.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yup. But because Robin was out during that time, we have to go from Kafka's side.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ooh, but didn't Kafka get knocked out by that convict too?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Oh, she sandbagged that one. So she says.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ah... okay, that adds up. It does seem like her style, yep.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Talk. Whose people sent you?

steps.name: B-Zone Prisoner A
steps.text: Heh... heh... you wouldn't... know.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...He's out.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: These people really were...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...Fine. Thinking about it now won't do anything. Let's see how these prisoners are first.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Looks like none of them crossed the river.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: And then this girl...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I don't know who you are, but you helped me back there...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Thank you, girl stranger.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You can call me Kafka.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Hm? You're not out?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh. Don't move. Just shift a bit to the right. Block the monitors.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Is this okay?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Golden. Surveillance shouldn't see me now.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Lucky for me, I checked around while I was cleaning the rooms.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I told you, call me Kafka. I'm here to help you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: But this is a real snafu. I was gonna leave you a slip of paper and call it there. Didn't expect those guys to suddenly go off.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What in the world is happening?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Not the right place to talk about that. Know anywhere good?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...The jailers should be coming over to see what the ruckus was. We can go to the clinic. That'll work.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: What in blue blazes?! Anthony, what the hell are you doing?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: That's what I'd like to ask, Barton.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: These prisoners snuck in with the intent to kill me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: What the hell are you doing?

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: It's the truth, Superintendent Barton. I witnessed Mr. Anthony fight off two inmates.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: What? Weren't you watching them?!

steps.name: Jailer B
steps.text: The two of them knocked me out. They were quite... no, very strong.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Rgh. Good for nothing.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: How do you want me to explain all this to the Warden?!

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Let's get a grip on the present first, Barton.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: These two are the assassins. You can deal with them.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: A—hem. Right, but Mr. Anthony, you see, we can't just take you at your word for all of this...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I've suffered minor injuries. I need a trip to the clinic first. They knocked everyone else unconscious. It might behoove you to send them all to the clinic too.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Once we're there, I will explain things in fine detail.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Barton
steps.text: What are you bunch navel-gazing for? Throw these two bodies in the morgue, and drag all of THEM with you!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Y-Yes, sir!

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: The jailers're all gone, Anthony.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: What happened? I saw them all looking perturbed some.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'd like to know too.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Alright. This place is safe, young Kafka.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Domma is my friend. If I could call anyone in this prison trustworthy, it'd be her.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: First off, drop that 'young.' I'm just some random li'l shortie.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Apologies, Miss Kafka.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Man, okay, you. For a prisoner, you're politer than all the people outside.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: This's how Anthony is. He don't hold back courtesy for anyone.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yeah, I get it. You look like a haymaker, but you've got manners for days too. Not surprising everyone else in here thinks you're a juggernaut.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You flatter me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Well, then. My turn to ask the questions. You're apparently here to aid me. That means you know where my assassins came from, I suppose?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uhh... before that, I need to ask you something first.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Please do.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You know what your family—or I guess your dad is the one Simon Co.'s named after—anyway, do you know exactly what happened there?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: As long as you do, I can explain things a lot simpler.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: My father was detained on more than ten charges. I know the circumstances couldn't have been simple, but I've had no time to find out concretely.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Okay, you know, yeah. That's good enough for me. Um, Simon Co., uh... thanks to ille... il... whawazzit?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Do you mean, 'illicit?'

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yeah, that! Illicit, smuggling, of Originium, goods! Anyway, the company got shut down, and the core members all went to prison.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: So your whole family's serving in Bunkerhill City right now.

a.text: Anthony slams a fist onto the nearby table. Everything on top of it rattles off.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...I'm alright.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I prepared myself to hear this a long time ago.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'm already happier than you could believe, knowing they're not dead.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Alright. Who sent them?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: HydeBro.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: HydeBro. So it was you.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Lemme just think. What did Silence say... Right, your family. The Simons. Were competing with them across some kind of line.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You were camping 50% of the profits each over this. And there was plenty of friction. So they always wanted to just camp your share too.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And then they did it. Pretty simple.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...HydeBro.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I heard my father mention that name often. I even visited their company as a guest once.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: They did all of this over a bit of selfishness...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'd heard of similar events before. I just never expected it'd happen around me.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony. Are you alright? Need me to use my Arts, settle your mind some?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: No, thank you, Domma.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I told you, I prepared myself for this long ago. I didn't expect the reality to come so sudden, that's all.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I believe you, Miss Kafka. I think there's no reason you'd have to deceive me about this.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Seeing how things are, those assassins ought to be from HydeBro. Why only come at this point?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: That, I have no idea at all. But judging by my experience, that wasn't the last of them just now.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: They've sent a whole bunch of people in to take you out for sure, so, uh, we should probably call this the very beginning.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: How about you? I presume you're not here just to help fend these killers off for me, are you? What's your objective, Miss Kafka?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Me? Mmm... it's kinda tough to explain fast, but let's say this: someone trusts me to help you break outta here.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You do wanna get out and take revenge, right?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: You got a life sentence. And it's the kind without parole.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: If you wanna leave this place, then you've got one choice, and that's—jailbreak.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: And that's why I'm here to help.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Obviously, if you don't wanna peace out and you're gonna stay here forever, it's not like I'm gonna force you to go.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Jailbreak... but no soul has ever made a clean escape from this prison.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Eyy. Say that if you want. But you can't knock it till you try it, right?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: ...You've been in this prison for a good while now, Miss Kafka.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Hm? Yeah, sure have.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Then you should have heard some things about me.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Yup. They all say you're the most powerful prisoner, and the most free. Pretty much everyone thinks you're strong as heck.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: I think you're pretty strong too, right now. Staying calm in times like these.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: But fact is, that's not what's happening.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Even with all this supposed 'charisma' I have, as a prisoner, I can't bend the jailers, let alone the warden. I should never have earned my current standing.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Eh, that's true enough. But you earned it now, so hey.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: In reality, what I've earned is the turnkeys' favor.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: At least, what little I know is that the warden himself said it. He told them to be 'slightly nicer' with me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: All these years, I've had suspicions. After I reached Ironforge City, I was arrested. Then I came to this prison. Did my father arrange for this from the start?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Foreseeing something, and sending me here in advance.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Such things have always spun in my mind.

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Oh, Silence mentioned that too. She said it was just one possibility, though.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Silence. Is that the name of your backer?

steps.name: Kafka
steps.text: Uh... whelp, whatever. Yeah, it is.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I'll be sure to thank this friend afterwards.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Anyway, it's just one possibility as you say. If I want to know the reason for sure, I'll need to get out. This is something only I can shine a light on.

steps.name: Domma
steps.text: Anthony, is it really alright to tell her this?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: It's fine. I believe you for the moment, Miss Kafka. Thus, I'm willing to level with you.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Even if you didn't show up—even if I'd long since gotten used to life in this prison—I've still yearned, incessantly, to leave here.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I can obtain most of what I want in here. But not since the beginning have I found the faintest outline of how to get out.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: So in truth, I should be the one asking you, Miss Kafka.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Please, help me break out.
